headline: Approved FY2027 budget as proposed and voted to accept Rousseau Family Trust painting donation, sending it to City Council for approval.
summary: The commission reviewed FY2027 budget items, including a $5000 Hell's Mural signage project and a 400+ Sculpture installation with quotes under $10000. Members approved the budget as proposed and voted unanimously to accept the Rousseau Family Trust donation. Approval of the prior meeting's minutes was tabled until August.
decisions: Tabled approval of the prior meeting minutes until the August meeting.
Tabled the Hell’s Mural signage item briefly to discuss the next agenda item.
Approved the FY2027 budget as proposed, passed unanimously.

Accepted the Rousseau Family Trust donation, with the two larger paintings placed in the city’s art collection, supporting materials archived, and the proposal submitted to City Council for approval, passed unanimously.

plain_text:
MEETING MINUTES
Note: All proposals, presentations, and/or documentation to be reviewed and 
discussed at this meeting can be viewed online at the following link: 
https://bit.ly/SalemPACProposals
Meeting called to order at 6:30 p.m.
Roll Call PAC: Jim Bostick (Chair), Bryan Apito, Gwendolyn Rosemond, Brittany Minton, 
Hannah Gathman
Arriving Late: Becky Fisher (6:40 p.m.)
Also Present: Staff: Julie Barry (Senior Planner Arts & Culture).
● Meeting Minutes Approval – May 19, 2026, Meeting Minutes
Minutes have been tabled until the August meeting.
 FY2027 Preliminary Budget Planning Continued
400+ Sculpture
 Quotes for the installation came in under $10000.
 Ms. Minton volunteers to registrar the installation.
Hell’s Mural
 $5000 for fabrication and installation of signage, approximately 6’x9’
This item is tabled, briefly, to discuss the next agenda item.
Ms. Barry will break out the conservation estimates for the Hells Gibson 
mural, mural slam objects, and the Rousseau gift.
Salem Public Art Commission
98 Washington Street
Salem, Massachusetts 01970
(978) 619-5685
DOMINICK PANGALLO
MAYOR Public Art Commission
July 21, 2026
6:30pm
Meeting held remotely via zoom
A motion to approve the budget as proposed is made by Jim Bostick, seconded by 
Brittany Minton, and passed unanimously.
 Rousseau Gift of Art Update
Ms. Minton feels that only 2 of the items belong in the city’s public art 
collection. Would like to accept the rest of the materials as supporting 
documentation context of the artwork.
 Mr. Bostick offers to help with the installation hardware for the 
two paintings. 
 Ms. Minton offers to transport the items to the high school.
A motion to accept the donation from the Rousseau Family Trust that the two larger 
paintings will be placed in the city’s art collections, supporting materials will be 
archived for research, and the Public Art Commission will submit the proposal to City
Council for approval is made by Jim Bostick, seconded by Hannah Gantham, and 
passes unanimously.
Mr. Bostick offers to help “shore up” the paintings once they are accepted 
into the public art collection and ensure the supporting materials and are in 
archival sleeves.
● Adjourn
Motion to adjourn is made by Gwendolyn Rosemund and passes unanimously.
Adjourn – The meeting adjourned at 8:37 pm
